visualCharacteristics.layout: Lined list of collapsible rows (native details/summary): a rule above the first and below every row, title on the left and a plus/minus indicator on the right; the panel opens below its title. Used for 'Contacts for media' (one row holding spokesperson contacts) and 'Our Highlights' topics. Option 'two-column' lays the items out in two columns on desktop (first half left, second half right), stacked on mobile

contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 = title (text or heading), cell 2 = panel content (rich text, contact fragments, images, links). A single-cell row uses its first element as title. A row without panel content renders as a plain lined row. Option two-column when the source shows accordions in two sibling columns (left column items first)
